verdicts.note: Direction holds against a sitting sheriff: he has never held elected office [S1] and asks for 'a fresh approach to leadership' [S9]. High confidence overstates the outsider case, though. His profile is long insider tenure in the same office: about 23 years in law enforcement, a Grant County deputy from 2006 and chief deputy over emergency management and special operations from 2016 to 2021 [S5][S6]. He also says he is 'not running simply to change things for the sake of change' and would build on what works [S13]. The renewal case is about who leads the office, not about an outsider profile, so +1 at medium.
